(1) STEP 3b, INSTRUMENT IDENTITY CHECKED, NOT ASSUMED, AND THE SIBLING wang_2026_* TABLES ARE A DIFFERENT STUDY. batch_217/218 shipped wang_2026_attitude/_behavioral_intention/_perceived_usefulness/_teaching_presence from Wang Y & Zou B, PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0346229, a TAM study of 500 Chinese EFL primary teachers on 1-5 scales with codes ATT/PU/TP/TA/BI. This table is Wang S & Zhang Z, PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0351162, 624 deposited veterans in Guizhou on a 1-7 scale with codes B1-B3. Different authors, different DOI, different deposit, different instrument; nothing was reused from those batches. Within this paper the table name is also correct: the live codes B1/B2/B3 are exactly the paper's Behavioral Expectations (BE) block, and the paper says 'Behavioral Expectations (BE) were measured using a seven-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (strongly disagree) to 7 (strongly agree) ... through items B1-B3'. (2) CODE DERIVATION, core model section 3 pattern 1: data/wang_2026_veteran_expectations.py sets ITEM_COLS = ['B1','B2','B3'] and melts those named columns of the S1 File .xlsx, so the IRW item code IS the deposit column header -- no positional step, no rename. (3) TEXT SOURCE / mapping_basis=paper_explicit, NOT data_labels: the .xlsx has one populated sheet whose header row carries bare codes and no variable or value labels of any kind (Sheet2/Sheet3 empty; 40 distinct strings in the whole workbook, all codes or category values), so the words come from the paper's Table 1, which IS the questionnaire and prints each item with the data's own code as a literal label ('B1. I hope that participation in grassroots governance can provide substantial income.'). Table 1 is published only as an IMAGE (the .t001 asset; the item wording is unreachable by grep over the article text), so the item text is an OCR-by-reading transcription of that image and is worth a human spot-check; punctuation was transcribed as printed, including B3's missing terminal period. (4) OPTION TEXT: Table 1 labels only the two endpoints of the BE block ('7-point Likert scale: 1 = Strongly disagree, 7 = Strongly agree') and prints bare checkboxes 1..7, so resp 2-6 ship with option_text blank rather than padded with their own numbers. instructions is the survey-wide line at the head of Table 1; section_prompt is blank (one trivial section, no testlet or passage structure). (5) LANGUAGE -- THE FALLBACK, AND THE ONE INFERENCE IN IT. The paper never states the administered language. The survey was delivered by mobile application through veterans affairs bureaus in 10 counties of Guizhou Province, China, to Chinese veterans, between 2024-02-15 and 2024-05-20, so it cannot have been administered in the English that Table 1 prints; language=Chinese is that inference, stated here rather than hidden. No Chinese wording is recoverable in scope: the article text contains zero CJK characters and the S1 File .xlsx contains zero CJK characters across all three sheets, and those are the only files the deposit has. So the 2026-09-01 fallback applies -- the authors' own English in the base fields, _translated columns empty, text_source=translated_substitute, translation_source=study_supplied. (6) SOURCE-DATA DISCREPANCY, not an itemtext defect: the paper reports 525 valid responses and analyses 525, but the deposited S1 File has 624 data rows and the IRW table has 624 ids x 3 items = 1872 rows. Nothing in the deposit marks which 525 were analysed. Consequently the published Cronbach's alpha for BE (Table 2, alpha=0.76) does not reproduce on the deposited 624: recomputed alpha is 0.66 (item intercorrelations B2-B3 0.62, B1-B3 0.29, B1-B2 0.24). This is a property of the deposited response data, recorded for the record; it does not affect the item-to-text mapping, which LINK 1 pins exactly. (7) RIGHTS: no restriction found to quote. The three items are the study's own; the paper's Table 1 cites Johansen, Laberg & Martinussen (2013) military-identity work only as a conceptual rationale ('Rationale: B2 (Assesses military identity [22])') and reproduces no instrument of theirs; the wording IRW ships was published by Wang & Zhang under CC BY 4.0. Silence is permission, so it ships.
